question: At first, there was a possibility that Regulus could die as he didn’t have a wife, so I think it would be necessary for him to rapidly gather wives. How did he procure his first wife?
answer: He wiped out the family of a childhood friend who (from Regulus’ point of view) had belittled him, broke her mind, and made her a bride. He made reasonably gallant efforts to take care of her, but I think he probably didn’t win her heart.
